output.reason: The regulation grants a government-borne (DTP) PPh 21 incentive for certain permanent employees (regular gross income up to Rp10,000,000 in January 2026 or in the first month of work) of employers in the footwear, textile and apparel, furniture, leather and tourism industries with the KLU codes listed in Lampiran A. It covers the January to December 2026 tax periods. The DTP amount is paid in cash to the employee and is not treated as taxable income, and any excess DTP is not refunded at year-end. These rules change the PPh 21 calculation for qualifying permanent employees.
